heading: Top stocks in focus today: Investors must watch Pine Labs, Waaree Energies, GRSE shares on Tue, 22 Sept | Triggers
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Indian investors will focus on companies like Pine Labs and Waaree Energies on September 22 due to significant business updates, including funding and expansion plans. Key players include Motilal Oswal, GK Energy, and Transrail Lighting.&nbsp;
